coverage.note: HIT. Static per-person giving pages at cadence.org/missionary/<first>-and-<first>-<last>/ (also <first>-<first>-<last>/ and <first>-<last>/ for singles). Directory indexes at cadence.org/donate/support-a-missionary, cadence.org/missionary-directory/, cadence.org/directory/, cadence.org/ministry-directory/ and cadence.org/student-ministry-staff/. Org states missionaries raise ministry expenses, benefits AND monthly salary, so headquarters/mobilization staff with a /missionary/ page are Tier A too. Mined for the rest of this run; the directory pages were never fetched, so the roster is almost certainly larger than what search surfaced.

HIT, found on the final search of the budget and therefore NOT mined. Two distinct static shapes: give.ratiochristi.org/missionary/<first>-<last> (per-person giving page) and give.ratiochristi.org/chapter/<university-name> (per-chapter giving page), with an index at give.ratiochristi.org/chapters. Org policy page states all staff must develop ministry partners and distinguishes 'Supported Missionary' chapter directors from volunteer tent-makers. This is the highest-value unworked seam left in this segment - it should get a dedicated agent.

MISS. Site is program content only (Edge Corps, summer training, NCC conference, speakers). Giving copy says 'support a staff member by giving directly to the ministry and campus of your choice' - i.e. giving is keyed to campus, not to a named person. No /staff/<name> pages surfaced.

MISS. Flat .html brochure site (connect.html, dmr.html, jaxstp.html). No staff directory page and no per-person pages. Only one person surfaced at all (a regional missions director, named in a snippet without an identifiable page) - logged in needs_review rather than emitted.

MISS on the per-person surface. Giving runs through give.stumo.org / register.stumo.org/managegiving and staff.stumo.org, which is LOGIN-GATED (staff.stumo.org/page/1276?returnurl=/ returns a login). Campus chapters do live on subdomains with flat staff rosters (e.g. tcu.stumo.org/staff.html) - that is a roster page, not a per-person giving page, and the names were not in the snippet. A future fetch-enabled wave could harvest <campus>.stumo.org/staff.html across chapters.

needs_review.finding: Ratio Christi publishes static per-person giving pages at give.ratiochristi.org/missionary/<first>-<last> and per-chapter pages at give.ratiochristi.org/chapter/<university>, with an index at give.ratiochristi.org/chapters. It was found on search 18 of 18, so only two people were captured.
needs_review.evidence: https://give.ratiochristi.org/missionary/ron-carter ; https://give.ratiochristi.org/missionary/jane-pantig/ ; https://give.ratiochristi.org/chapters ; https://ratiochristi.org/join/application-interview-process/ (states all staff develop ministry partners; 'Supported Missionary' vs volunteer tent-maker chapter directors)
needs_review.recommendation: Dispatch a dedicated agent against give.ratiochristi.org with a full budget. Rotate university names as qualifiers against site:give.ratiochristi.org/missionary - the chapter index gives the campus list. Screen out volunteer tent-maker chapter directors, who are explicitly NOT support-funded and are therefore not Tier A.

needs_review.finding: Cadence exposes at least five index pages that would enumerate the whole roster in one fetch, but page fetching is blocked this wave and search only returns ~10 slugs per query.
needs_review.recommendation: Hand these five URLs to a fetch-enabled wave; the /missionary/<slug>/ shape is already confirmed so the index alone converts straight into records.

needs_review.issue: Retired / emeritus Cadence staff may be mixed into the roster
needs_review.finding: Several Cadence /missionary/ pages describe ministry in the past tense or with historical date ranges (e.g. a couple who directed a hospitality house 1998-2013). Cadence appears to keep pages for long-tenured and possibly retired staff alongside active ones, and search snippets do not reliably distinguish them.
needs_review.recommendation: All are emitted Tier A because each still carries a live giving ask, but flag at ingest for an active/retired check before any outreach.
